tweets.text:
The S&P 500 is up on the year, and until October it looked like a normal bull market year. It wasn't.

Price is earnings times the multiple. To understand a market, you have to separate the two.

The AI capex build-out sent 12-month forward earnings up 39%. But higher bond yields and tightening financial conditions crushed the multiple, from 23.3x a year ago to 17.3x today.

That's why so many people spent 2026 asking why equities weren't falling as war broke out in the Middle East. The answer was earnings.

Earnings did the heavy lifting, but beneath the surface, liquidity quietly took it back.

The problem is that earnings can't do it again. Forward earnings are now further above their long-run trend than in 99% of months since December 1967, and my models say we're at peak earnings.

2027 flips the script.

My MACROSHARK 2027 Macro Outlook is out Friday, and it's a big one...

Price is earnings times the multiple. To understand a market, you have to separate the two.

The AI capex build-out sent 12-month forward earnings up 39%. But higher bond yields and tightening financial conditions crushed the multiple, from 23.3x a year ago to 17.3x today.

That's why so many people spent 2026 asking why equities weren't falling as war broke out in the Middle East. The answer was earnings.

Earnings did the heavy lifting, but beneath the surface, liquidity quietly took it back.

The problem is that earnings can't do it again. Forward earnings are now further above their long-run trend than in 99% of months since December 1967, and my models say we're at peak earnings.

2027 flips the script.

My MACROSHARK 2027 Macro Outlook is out Friday, and it's a big one...
